tax.heading: (Loss) income before income taxes
tax.text: We had a loss before income taxes of US$0.4 million and an income before income taxes US$0.1 million in the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Our operating margin was negative 35.9% and 6.4% in the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

net.text: As a result of the foregoing, we reported net loss of US$0.1 million and net income of US$0.1 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

ocf.heading: Operating activities
ocf.text:
Net cash provided by operating activities for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was US$6.0 million, as compared to the net loss of US$0.1 million. The difference was primarily attributable to changes in operating assets and liabilities including (i) an increase of US$12.3 million in loans receivables due from third party customers we expanded our loan business in the three months ended June 30, 2026, (ii) a decrease of US$12.2 million in receivables from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, and (iii) an increase of US$5.0 million in payables to customers due to an increase in futures accounts.

Net cash provided by operating activities for the three months ended June 30, 2025 was US$7.1 million, as compared to the net income of US$0.1 million. The difference was primarily attributable to changes in operating assets and liabilities including (i) an increase of US$1.1 million in loans receivables due from third party customers, (ii) an increase of US$0.2 million in receivables from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, and (iii) an increase of US$8.9 million in payables to customers due to an increase in futures accounts.

sbc.text: Compensation and benefits represent the salaries, performance based discretionary bonuses and contribution to retirement fund, and share-based compensation expenses to non-executive directors. Compensation and benefits expenses accounted for 53.0% and 32.5% of our revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

net sales.heading: Revenues
net sales.text: Our revenues consist of commissions, trading solution services and other service revenues, trading gains, interest income and others. The following table sets forth the breakdown of our total revenues, both in absolute amount and as a percentage of our total revenues, for the years indicated:

Interest income from loan business.heading: Interest income from loan business
Interest income from loan business.text: For the year ended March 31, 2024, we launched the loan business to third party customers. The business was approved by the Hong Kong Licensing Court under the Money Lenders Ordinance. The Company disbursed loans to customers for a fixed period and charged interests from the customers. The principal and interest are repayable upon the maturity of the loans. We recognized interest income using straight-line method over loan period. For the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, we recognized interest income of US$0.4 million and US$0.2 million from loan business, accounting for 38.6% and 17.8% of total revenues, respectively.

Other service revenues.heading: Other service revenues
Other service revenues.text:
Other service revenues represent the revenues generated from rendering other financial services including securities brokerage, consulting services, and currency exchange services. We generally receive subscription fees calculated with reference to the amount subscribed by our clients of the structured products. For the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, other service revenues accounted for 34.8% and 2.3% of total revenues, respectively.

For options trading, we have the capacity to offer options trading services and they are available to our clients. However, there was no revenue generated from options trading services for the relevant periods.

Virtual asset brokerage commissions.heading: Virtual asset brokerage commissions
Virtual asset brokerage commissions.text: Virtual asset brokerage commissions represent commission income on virtual asset conversion from/into US dollar that are charged at a fixed rate for each transaction our customers executed through our online trading platforms, all of which are under the consolidated accounts where the customer information is not disclosed to the third-party broker. We receive commissions from customers. The virtual asset brokerage service cannot be cancelled once it has been executed and is not refundable, so returns and allowances are not applicable. Commissions are charged for each customer trade order executed. Commissions from virtual asset broking make up for most of our revenues at 6.9% of the total revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

net.text: As a result of the foregoing, we reported net income of US$0.3 million and US$0.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

ocf.heading: Operating activities
ocf.text:
Net cash used in operating activities for the six months ended September 30, 2026 was US$2.4 million, as compared to the net income of US$0.2 million. The difference was primarily attributable interest income from loan business of US$1.5 million and changes in operating assets and liabilities including (i) an increase of US$10.0 million in loans receivables due from third party customers we expanded our loan business in the six months ended September 30, 2026, (ii) a decrease of US$6.9 million in receivables from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, (iii) a decrease of US$1.7 million in receivable form customers due to collection, (iv) an increase of US$2.4 million in prepayment as we made advances to one supplier for procurement of API model, and (v) an increase of US$2.4 million in contract liabilities for advance from customers for AI services.

Net cash provided by operating activities in the six months ended September 30, 2025 was US$11.3 million, as compared to the net income of US$0.2 million. The difference was primarily attributable to changes in operating assets and liabilities including (i) an increase of US$8.6 million in receivables from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, and (ii) an increase of US$17.3 million in payables to customers because more customers placed deposits with the Company for higher trading volume.

The following table sets forth the breakdown of our total revenues, both in absolute amount and as a percentage of our total revenues, for the years indicated:

Interest income from loan business.heading: Interest income from loan business
Interest income from loan business.text: The Company disbursed loans to customers for a fixed period and charged interests from the customers. The principal and interest are repayable upon the maturity of the loans. We recognized interest income using straight-line method over loan period. For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, we recognized interest income of US$1.4 million and US$0.2 million from loan business, accounting for 62.7% and 15.5% of total revenues, respectively. For the six months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, we recognized interest income of US$1.8 million and US$0.5 million from loan business, accounting for 54.8% and 16.5% of total revenues, respectively.

Other service revenues.heading: Other service revenues
Other service revenues.text: Other service revenues represent the revenues generated from rendering other financial services including securities brokerage, consulting services, and currency exchange services. We generally receive subscription fees calculated with reference to the amount subscribed by our clients of the structured products. For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, other service revenues accounted for 14.4% and 7.5% of total revenues, respectively. For the six months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, other service revenues accounted for 21.1% and 5.1% of total revenues, respectively.

AI Services.heading: AI Services
AI Services.text: In August 2026, our Board of Directors approved a major strategic initiative to expand the use of artificial intelligence (AI) across its core financial business. Under this new technical mandate, we will develop and deploy advanced AI solutions designed to create scalable, technology-driven business lines while directly supporting and optimizing our core fintech operations. We will deeply embed tools across its core operational entities. The goal is to revolutionize the user experience, optimize administrative costs, and enhance data reporting capabilities. Specific system integrations include Online Brokerage & Asset Management, Predictive Risk Assessment, Wealth Management & Advisory, Investment Banking Workflow. We charge AI service fees based on the number of AI models consumed by our customers.

Trading gains (losses).heading: Trading gains (losses)
Trading gains (losses).text: The trading gains (losses) mainly consist of realized and unrealized gains and losses from investment in US and HK stocks, which are included in Securities owned, at fair value. Trading gains made up for 2.9% and 21.5% of total revenues for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Trading losses make up for negative 1.8% and trading gains made up for 17.8% of total revenues for the six months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

Interest income and other.heading: Interest income and others
Interest income and other.text:
During the three months ended September 30, 2026, the interest income was comprised of $49,875 of interest income charged on our customer who traded HK & US stocks, interest income earned on deposits maintained with brokerage institutions, and interest income earned on bank deposits, including term deposits. During the six months ended September 30, 2026, the interest income was comprised of $0.2 million of interest income charged on our customer who traded HK & US stocks, interest income earned on deposits maintained with brokerage institutions, and interest income earned on bank deposits, including term deposits.

During the three months ended September 30, 2025, the interest income was comprised of $0.1 million of interest income charged on our clients who traded US stocks and interests earned on bank deposits. During the six months ended September 30, 2025, the interest income was comprised of $0.2 million of interest income charged on our clients who traded US stocks and interests earned on bank deposits.

We receive commissions from customers. The virtual asset brokerage service cannot be cancelled once it has been executed and is not refundable, so returns and allowances are not applicable. Commissions are charged for each customer trade order executed. Commissions from virtual asset broking make up for most of our revenues at 1.3% and 3.1% of the total revenues for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, respectively.

The sole shareholder is a company incorporated under the laws of Hong Kong, of which a family member of Ms. Junli Yang, the Chairwoman of the Board, and Ms. Yung Yung Lo, the Chief Financial Officer, hold 71.50% and 8.30% equity interests, respectively. Pursuant to the agreement, ZYNL agreed to purchase 100% of the equity interest in the Target for a total purchase price of HKD500,000 (approximately US$63,750). See “Item 13. lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
